name: Card
description: An everyday card with media, a header, content and a footer, which can also be a link or a selectable option.

props.name: variant
props.description: Default is a raised card with a hairline and a soft shadow. Outline keeps the hairline with no fill or shadow. Muted is a sunken well with no border or shadow.

props.name: size
props.description: Padding of the parts and the gap between them: 16 and 12 pixels, or 24 and 16.

props.name: selectable
props.description: Makes the whole card a checkbox. Space or a click toggles it, and a round badge in the top corner fills with water when it is on. Keep the content simple: nothing else inside should be interactive.

props.name: isSelected
props.description: Whether a selectable card is on (controlled).

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Whether a selectable card starts on (uncontrolled).

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Called when a selectable card is toggled.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables a selectable card and dims it to 50%.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name of a selectable card.

props.name: value
props.description: Value submitted with the form when a selectable card is on.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the card. Also accepts every div prop. A selectable card takes its accessible name from its CardTitle unless you pass aria-label or aria-labelledby.

props.name: children
props.description: CardTitle, then CardDescription under it, and an optional CardAction that sits in the top end corner.

props.name: href
props.description: Turns the title into a link whose hit area covers the whole card. Hovering the card raises its shadow and colours the title; keyboard focus rings the whole card. Buttons inside the card stay clickable above the link.

props.name: target
props.description: Link target, used with href.

props.name: rel
props.description: Link relationship, used with href.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Renders an h3 and accepts its props.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Muted text under the title; accepts every p prop.

props.name: children
props.description: A small button or menu trigger in the header's top end corner, beside the title and aligned with its first line. The description runs the full width under both.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. The body of the card, padded to match the header; accepts every div prop.

props.name: bordered
props.description: Adds a hairline across the top of the footer, with equal space above and below its content.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. A row with an 8 pixel gap; accepts every div prop.

props.name: src
props.description: Image address. The image covers the box and is cropped to fit.

props.name: alt
props.description: Text alternative for the image. Leave it empty when the image is decoration.

props.name: aspect
props.description: Aspect ratio of the box, as a number or a CSS ratio.

props.name: children
props.description: Anything else to show in the box, such as a video, when src is not set.
